verdict.rationale: Lambda itself only exposes a REST API (docs-1..41) with no first-party natural-language or agent interface; the only NL-command capability comes from a third-party developer's unofficial CLI/MCP server that lets AI agents launch/terminate instances via commands like 'launch an H100' (lambda-labs-comm-3). This is an extra, unofficial tool rather than a supported product feature. missing for 10: first-party NL/agent interface, official MCP server or chat-based control, documentation of natural-language command support.
